name: Twilight Horizon
detailed_description:
Cielo wakes up to find herself on an airplane trapped in a dark dimension known as the Twilight Zone. Surrounded by fear, desperation, and something lurking beyond comprehension, the passengers and crew begin to unravel. You can’t save everyone, but what will you do to save yourself?

In the far future, Dr. Luna leads an experiment to harness energy from the Twilight Zone. The operation fails catastrophically, resulting in the destruction of a space station. As madness from the other side seeps in, Luna must face the consequences and try to make things right, even when there’s nothing left to save.

Twilight Horizon is a story-driven RPG Maker horror game featuring two parallel protagonists.

Play as Cielo: Discover the mystery of the doomed flight. Use supernatural abilities to unveil hidden dimensions and collect fragments of memory.

Play as Luna: Survive the crumbling space station in the shadow of a soulless industry. Use logic and scientific knowledge to solve puzzles and outsmart terrifying threats.

Features

  • Surreal, immersive atmosphere: Explore haunting locations like a forever-drifting airplane, a mysterious island, and an abandoned space station.

  • Distinct visual style: A fusion of anime aesthetics and horror, featuring numerous hand-drawn cutscene illustrations.

  • Memorable characters: Build relationships with passengers and crew, each with rich, emotionally grounded backstories.

  • Deep lore: A twisted world blending science fiction, dark fantasy, and dystopia, with strong psychological horror themes.

  • Unique character abilities: Survive through exploration, puzzle-solving, and each protagonist’s distinct skills, no combat required.

  • Original soundtrack: Over 20 atmospheric tracks composed by Yokaisynth, blending dark ambient and darksynth to heighten the tension and mood.

short_description: A surreal sci-fi horror RPG. Play as two protagonists, trapped in two doomed realities. Uncover secrets, solve puzzles, and survive industrial nightmares in a haunting journey through the Twilight Zone.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft Windows® 10 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Compatible OpenGL / VRAM 1GB or better
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display

content_descriptors.notes: Twilight Horizon contains scenes involving violence, blood, and gore.
